# mulberry32

## Summary

A tiny seeded pseudo-random number generator: given a 32-bit seed it returns a function producing deterministic floats in [0, 1). It is what makes every procedural surface finish reproducible — the same material id always paints the same grime blotches, scratches, and streaks, so a model looks identical on every rebuild.

## Import

```ts
import { mulberry32 } from '../util/finishes';
```

## Usage

`makeFinishTexture` in the same module seeds it from the material id (via the FNV-1a `seedFrom` helper) and hands the generator to each finish painter. It is also a member of `FINISH_RUNTIME_SOURCES`, which `../util/code-export` emits verbatim via `Function.prototype.toString()` into exported model .js files, so standalone models paint their finishes with exactly the same RNG.
